I ragazzi cercano di sostituire il grano come cereale principale dell’accademia, per questo fondano un gruppo che si fa chiamare “Love Rice” e che si esibisce durante il Festival del Raccolto, uno spettacolo live, per esaltare le qualità dei chicchi di riso.

info.synopsis: Agli Iolph, esseri sospesi tra realtà e leggenda che smettono di invecchiare una volta raggiunta l'adolescenza, è vietato intrattenere rapporti con i normali umani. Makia, orfana dei genitori, trascorre le giornate in modo pacifico finchè gli Iolph vengono attaccati dai cavalieri del regno di Marzate, che rapiscono tutte le donne in cerca del segreto dell'immortalità. Leilia, la ragazza più bella del clan, viene strappata alle braccia del suo amato Krim e destinata in sposa al principe Hazel. Makia riesce invece a scappare e mentre vaga da sola nella foresta trova Erial, un neonato orfano di cui diventerà la madre adottiva.
info.title: Maquia: When the Promised Flower Blooms (ITA)

episodes.synopsis: Saint Cecilia is kind, giving guidance to all. The moment they leave, her saintly manner vanishes. Pastor Lawrence is patient with her, if overprotective, and shows no signs of noticing her feelings for him. One day, they head into the village, and...
episodes.title: Episodio 1

episodes.synopsis: Lawrence's friend Abel comes to visit and says he plans to work with them for a little while. Lawrence's frank manner with his friend is new to Cecilia. When trouble befalls Lawrence, Cecilia panics, but Abel stays calm. The truth is, he has a secret.
episodes.title: Episodio 2

episodes.synopsis: Abel comes down with a fever and Cecilia insists on looking after him. Lawrence feels a puzzling sense of unease. When he finds Cecilia sleeping near Abel, he speaks curtly to Cecilia and immediately regrets it. What could be making him act this way?
episodes.title: Episodio 3

episodes.synopsis: There's a knock at the church door. Abel answers it, then slams the door closed again, to no avail. The visitor, Hazelita, has come looking for him and also to see the lady saint. When she mets Cecilia, her manner toward Lawrence turns cold. But why?
episodes.title: Episodio 4

episodes.synopsis: Lawrence, Cecilia, and the others visit the elderly Corinne. Her home stands near a beautiful lake. Cecilia and Abel each notice something odd about it. Corinne asks for Lawrence's help about the voices she hears at night and he investigates...alone.
episodes.title: Episodio 5

episodes.synopsis: Cecilia helps out at a short-staffed cafe while waiting for Lawrence to finish his errands. When Lawrence finds out about her job, he can't help worrying! Later, Abel receives an envelope containing something Cecilia has been desperately longing for.
episodes.title: Episodio 6

episodes.synopsis: Lawrence's recent strange behavior has Cecilia worried. Upon hearing her fears, Hazelita leaps into action. They follow him into town where something unforeseen happens. Later, a letter arrives, summoning Lawrence to the town where Hazelita's family lives.
episodes.title: Episodio 7

episodes.synopsis: Giselbert treats Cecilia and the others to a lavish dinner. The next day, Cecilia tours the city with Lawrence. She notices that he isn't well. He says that his head has hurt since they passed a certain garden—a place which Hazelita will never forget.
episodes.title: Episodio 8

episodes.synopsis: Lawrence wants to know more about lady saints, so Cecilia and Giselbert explain what they can. Giselbert holds a farewell party for Cecilia and the others. How will Lawrence react to Cecilia's party attire, and why is Camilla asking her so many questions?
episodes.title: Episodio 9

episodes.synopsis: Cecilia and Lawrence return home. He's immediately busy with work, and she's depressed that they can't spend more time together. When Cecilia can't fall asleep, it gives her a chance to spend time with Lawrence. Then, an accident sets her heart racing!
episodes.title: Episodio 10

episodes.synopsis: Hazelita hopes that giving Cecilia and Lawrence more time alone together will help their relationship progress. She convinces Abel to get involved, too. Meanwhile, Lawrence isn't sure how he should interact with Cecilia. He recalls the first day they met.
episodes.title: Il loro incontro

episodes.synopsis: Lawrence isn't able to express who Cecilia is to him. A comment from Eric helps Lawrence to see a possible form for their relationship. As the whole village sparkles with the lively energy of the winter festival, Lawrence takes Cecilia to a certain spot.
episodes.title: La forma della loro relazione

info.synopsis:
Le avventure in un mondo fantastico di un pastore, bravo a cucinare e dal carattere iperprotettivo nei confronti di una suora.
Keywords:
info.title: Saint Cecilia and Pastor Lawrence

episodes.synopsis: Una sera Yor torna a casa dal lavoro e sembra essere di pessimo umore. Loid, temendo che il suo finto matrimonio stia fallendo, invita Yor a trascorrere una giornata da solo con lui per rilassarsi.
episodes.title: Pediniamo papà e mamma

episodes.synopsis: Yor prepara il pasto di Bond, poiché si è dimenticata di comprargli delle crocchette. Tuttavia, Bond si considera ancora troppo giovane per lasciare questo mondo e decide di andare alla ricerca dell'unica persona che può salvarlo dal mangiare un pasto avvelenato.
episodes.title: La strategia di sopravvivenza di Bond - La gita educativa di Damian

episodes.synopsis: A Yuri viene assegnata la missione di monitorare un ex giornalista per vedere se scrive notizie false sulla loro madrepatria. L'eroe dei cartoni animati preferito di Anya, Bondman, mostra le sue eleganti mosse da spia!!
episodes.title: Missione famiglia - L'elegante Bondman

episodes.synopsis: Il leggendario dessert dell'Eden finalmente appare! Per ottenere gli amaretti che presumibilmente possono trasformarti in un  Imperial Scholar se mangiati, Anya e le sue amiche corrono per raggiungerli per primi.
episodes.title: Il dolce della conoscenza - Il grande Piano Romantico dell'informatore II

episodes.synopsis: A Yor viene assegnata una nuova missione che differisce da quelle che è abituata a svolgere. Questa volta dovrà proteggere due persone che degli assassini stanno cercando di uccidere.
episodes.title: Operazione espatrio

episodes.synopsis: Dopo l'imbarco sulla nave da crociera, Yor inizia il suo dovere di guardia del corpo.
episodes.title: La spaventosa nave da crociera di lusso

episodes.synopsis: Yor e i suoi clienti sono ora il bersaglio degli assassini sulla nave da crociera. Anya e Loid, invece, approfittano di tutte le attività a loro disposizione.
episodes.title: A chi giova questo lavoro

episodes.synopsis: Yor continua a respingere i crescenti attacchi degli assassini. Nel frattempo, Anya si gode i fuochi d'artificio sul mare.
episodes.title: Sinfonia sulla nave - L'infuso di mia sorella

episodes.synopsis: Yor continua la sua lotta contro gli assassini.  Anya cerca di sbarazzarsi di suo padre per aiutare sua madre. Loid scopre delle bombe a bordo della nave.
episodes.title: La mano che afferra il futuro

episodes.synopsis: La famiglia Forger trascorre una giornata in famiglia su in'isola. Una volta tornata, Anya pensa solo a una cosa: vantarsi per impressionare Damian.
episodes.title: Godersi l'isola turistica - Vantarsi della vacanza

episodes.synopsis: Becky finalmente decide di incontrare il padre di Anya, l'uomo di cui è perdutamente innamorata da quando lo ha visto nella foto di famiglia della sua compagna di classe.
episodes.title: Berlint Love - Una normale giornata di Nightfall

episodes.synopsis: Mentre Bond è a passeggio con Loid, ha la premonizione di un incidente, quindi cerca di fermarlo, ma viene rimproverato da Loid. Poi ha la visione di un edificio in fiamme e di una ragazza che singhiozza in piedi di fronte ad esso.
episodes.title: Parte della famiglia

episodes.synopsis: When an overworked office worker wakes up, she finds herself in the world of her favorite otome game, “Falling Stars: Astrolabe of Love.” And what’s more, she’s reincarnated as Diana, the villainess! On top of that, Prince Sirius, the character she’s trying to win over, approaches Diana, the villainess, not Chris, the game’s heroine...!
episodes.title: Episodio 1

episodes.synopsis: When the villainess and Sirius get together, there will be a Bad End. Diana, who knows the truth about the game, struggles to keep Sirius away from her. However, Sirius refuses to give up. Diana has no choice but to try to force Sirius and Chris together.
episodes.title: Episodio 2

episodes.synopsis: Diana has been hit by Sirius's passionate feelings. But, despite her mixed feelings, Sirius still makes her heart race. So then, to find out why the prince is in love with the villainess, she visits a place they seem to have shared a significant memory.
episodes.title: Episodio 3

episodes.synopsis: A mysterious envelope arrives with a cryptic message, but Diana ignores it and goes to sleep. When she wakes up the next day, the person sleeping next to her is... Spica, Diana's cousin, and another of Chris's targets. With his appearance, Sirius's behavior is different from usual... is there turmoil on the horizon?
episodes.title: Episodio 4

episodes.synopsis: Diana is locked in a prison by Spica. Not understanding why she was trapped there, she searches her cell and finds Diana's diary. What's more, there was a shocking truth written in it! Meanwhile, Sirius, who came to the Diafell household to see Diana, feels something is off when Diana is not there.
episodes.title: Episodio 5

episodes.synopsis: Diana is brought to the castle by Sirius, as their shadows gradually overlap. Meanwhile, Spica grieves as he stares at the empty prison Diana left behind. Just then, Spica gets some surprising new information from his servant.
episodes.title: Episodio 6

episodes.synopsis: Diana is joined with Sirius in the end. She tells herself that this is the first and last time she will be happy with him. The following morning, Diana tries to say that she will keep her distance from Sirius. But suddenly, Spica and his servant come barging in.
episodes.title: Episodio 7

episodes.synopsis: Sirius asks Diana about the Diafell family's plans. She gives up and decides to reveal everything to Sirius and face her punishment. However, Sirius makes a surprising proposal to Diana.
episodes.title: Episodio 8

info.synopsis: Una office lady viene trasportata nel suo otome preferito, Hoshifuru Koi no Astrolabe, dove si reincarna nell'antagonista Diana. Nonostante la trama del gioco voglia che il principe Sirius si innamori della protagonista, quest'ultimo si avvicinerà invece a Diana: ciò provocherebbe la bad ending che porta alla distruzione del mondo. Per evitare ogni disgrazia, lei proverà a comportarsi in maniera volgare con il principe per allontanarlo, ma lui cascherà ugualmente fra le braccia della cattiva...
info.title: Game World Reincarnation

episodes.synopsis: Yakumo Fugii, an ordinary Japanese student, inherits the care of Pai, a young girl from Nepal, from his dying archaeologist father. But Pai is more than she innocently appears to be. She is the last of a vanished magical race known as the Sanjiyan Unkara, or Triclops, and is in a desperate hunt against the forces of darkness to find the Ningen no Zou (Statue of Humanity) to turn her human. Yakumo nearly dies in a fight against a demon and to save him, Pai turns him into a Wu, a zombie bound to her service who cannot die. Yakumo and Pai travel to Hong Hong to meet with Ling Ling Lee, a colleague of his father's, to track down the statue. But, the demons of the dark lord Kaiyan Wang are already there to retrieve it...whatever the cost.
episodes.title: Reincarnazione

episodes.synopsis: Yakumo and Pai return to Japan from Hong Kong after the Statue of Humanity disappears from the mysterious Mrs. Huang's mansion. Yakumo returns to school and his friends in the hopes of resuming a normal life. But nothing is normal when you're an undead zombie bound to a magical being and demons start attacking your schoolmates on the playground!
episodes.title: Yakumo

episodes.synopsis: Yakumo and Pai return to Hong Kong when the Statue of Humanity turns up in the possession of Steve Long, another Monster Buster, Inc colleague. Before they can reach it, Steve and the statue are kidnapped. Yakumo, Pai, Ling Ling, and Steve's sister Meixing attempt a rescue. But it's all a trap to catch Pai, the statue, and Meixing in a human sacrifice to release the dark spirit of Kaiyan Wang!
episodes.title: Sacrificio

episodes.synopsis: Yakumo, Pai, and the crew of Monster Buster, Inc celebrate their recapture of the statue at Madame Huang's estate, but the party is spoiled by a gruesome challenge delivered by a powerful Wu of Kaiyan Wang's. Pai meets the Wu for a showdown at Aberdeen Harbor and half the harbor is destroyed in the aftermath. How will Yakumo continue on without the anchor of his life?
episodes.title: Scomparsa

info.synopsis: Pai, l'ultima discendente del popolo dei Ciclopi, creature immortali dotate di tre occhi, vuole a tutti i costi assumere sembianze umane per lasciarsi alle spalle il suo passato. Un professore in fin di vita di nome Fuji invia una lettera a suo figlio Yakumo chiedendogli di aiutarla. Quest'ultimo, in seguito ad una serie di avvenimenti, diventa il suo sorvegliante personale. Insieme si mettono sulle tracce della Statua dell'Umanità, attraverso la quale è possibile trasformarsi in esseri umani. Non sono gli unici alla ricerca della statuetta, dovranno infatti vedersela con numerosi nemici assetati di gloria e potere. Ma nonostante gli ostacoli, riusciranno i due a raggiungere il loro obiettivo?
info.title: 3x3 Eyes (ITA)

episodes.synopsis: When Buchio, a 20-year-old cat, is reborn as a nekomata, his family happily accepts him. As young Mutsumi worries about her missing father, Jiro the crow tengu comforts her. Tales of a mysterious yet warm day-to-day life shared by humans, gods, and yokai begin here.
episodes.title: Episodio 1

episodes.synopsis: As Buchio ponders what to do with his new life, Yuri the bakegitsune teaches him how to transform. Rain, a kappa in Ryo's class who has a crush on him, sees a certain someone for romantic advice...
episodes.title: Episodio 2

episodes.synopsis: Takumi and Buchio encounter a mythical beast said to bring misfortune to those who hear its voice. Mutsumi learns that Jiro once killed a giant serpent, but it turns out the serpent remained as a vengeful spirit...
episodes.title: Episodio 3

episodes.synopsis: Buchio starts attending driving school, where he meets a tsukumogami who's inhabited a car. Meanwhile, at the elementary school, a raiju falls from a rift in the sky...
episodes.title: Episodio 4

episodes.synopsis: Seeing Buchio enjoying a happy life with his family makes Yuri remember her tumultuous past with her own family, leaving her angry and irritable. Then she finds herself caught up in an unbelievable incident...
episodes.title: Episodio 5

episodes.synopsis: After returning from the parallel world, Yuri is finally ready to stop living in the past. To set herself free, she sets off to visit the family home she left behind many years ago under the crushing weight of pride and tradition.
episodes.title: Episodio 6

episodes.synopsis: Buchio grapples with a concern that all yokai like him eventually face: the fact that his lifespan is much longer than that of humans. His new friend Wagen has been dealing with the same concern in his life with his aging partner, Kazuhiko.
episodes.title: Episodio 7

episodes.synopsis: Buchio realizes that the source of his fear is loneliness, and learns the importance of living in the here and now. Jiro reveals the sad memories he's kept locked up inside in his efforts to avoid worrying Mutsumi.
episodes.title: Episodio 8

episodes.synopsis: Rain learns that she's been feeling so cold lately because her body is trying to revert to its kappa origins. The doctor warns her to avoid catching a chill, but when Ryo is dragged into the river, she can't stop herself from diving in after him.
episodes.title: Episodio 9

episodes.synopsis: A strange shadow appears near the Sugimoto house and nearly swallows Mutsumi. Jiro and Tazenbo manage to save her at the last moment. As Mutsumi recovers, they question the shadow about its obsession with her.
episodes.title: Episodio 10

episodes.synopsis: Takumi is curious to see the Space-Time Laboratory scientists in action, and Buchio accompanies him to observe them. A catastrophe strikes when Buchio is called away to Tokyo on business.
episodes.title: Episodio 11

episodes.synopsis: A boundary break causes an army of oni to appear from a rift in the sky and attack people. Jiro saves the Suginami family from attack, but then he makes a shocking observation about the oni...
episodes.title: Episodio 12

episodes.synopsis: The world is inverted, and all the yokai born of kotodama collapse one after another. Even Buchio and Jiro... Can the world be restored to normal?
episodes.title: Episodio 13

info.synopsis: La storia è ambientata in una città rurale dove yokai, esseri umani e divinità vivono la loro quotidianità in un mix di calore e mistero. Un'estate, il gatto ventenne Buchio si evolve improvvisamente in un nekomata. Impensierito da questa trasformazione, si ripromette di scoprirne di più insieme a Yuri, che si sta trasformando in una kitsune. Muu-chan spia il corvo-tengu Jirou mentre svolge i suoi doveri di tengu e inizia a vederlo sotto una nuova luce. Allo stesso tempo, iniziano a diffondersi voci su una sfortunata nue...
info.title: Tonari no Yokai-san

episodes.title: Cinderella of the Cherry Blossom Moonlight

info.synopsis: Fra il 1996 ed il 1997, sono state prodotte due serie OAV di tre episodi ciascuna. Successivamente è stata trasmessa in Giappone una serie televisiva anime di ventisei episodi dall’aprile al settembre 1999. La serie televisiva racconta una versione alternativa della storia degli OAV.
info.title: Starship Girl Yamamoto Yohko II

episodes.synopsis: Takuma's job keeps him so busy he has no time for chores, so he buys a housekeeping robot named Mina. After he jokes with her that she should be his wife, some unexpected facets of her programming begin to emerge.
episodes.title: Episodio 1

episodes.synopsis: Takuma and Mina walk to a local park for a picnic. This brings with it new discoveries, but also a range of challenges, as they each learn more about the dynamics of their unusual relationship.
episodes.title: Episodio 2

episodes.synopsis: Akari can't believe her big brother Takuma suddenly has a wife from out of nowhere, and her mission to screen this new addition to the family results in some unexpected twists.
episodes.title: Episodio 3

episodes.synopsis: Takuma, Mina, and Akari head out for a day at the beach. While waiting for the ladies to get changed into swimsuits, Takuma has an unexpected encounter with someone he finds oddly familiar.
episodes.title: Episodio 4

episodes.synopsis: Mina starts exploring the logistics of kissing, which leads to some hard lessons for her and Takuma. Super Mina drops by with an unexpected thank-you gift, but Takuma and Mina don't react to it the same way.
episodes.title: Episodio 5

episodes.synopsis: The proceedings turn out to be something other than business as usual when an Ichijo Robotics employee drops by to collect Mina for her scheduled upgrades and maintenance.
episodes.title: Episodio 6

episodes.synopsis: Takuma has to look after himself while Mina is away at the factory receiving her upgrades. But the arrival of a small robot helper ends up changing the situation more than either of them anticipates.
episodes.title: Episodio 7

episodes.synopsis: Mina works on teaching Mamoru how to use his built-in features. Takuma and Mamoru go out on the town, and Takuma learns quite a bit about his young companion, as well as about how society treats robots in general.
episodes.title: Episodio 8

episodes.synopsis: Super Mina realizes she and Mina have accidentally swapped some memories. During an attempt to straighten things out, some unexpected information about Mina's former owner comes to light.
episodes.title: Episodio 9

episodes.synopsis: Mina goes grocery shopping with Mamoru, and spends time teaching him written Japanese. The bond developing between these two comes as a surprise to Takuma, who isn't entirely sure how to react.
episodes.title: Episodio 10

episodes.synopsis: Takuma's Uncle Koshiro drops by unannounced, and cooks some food for Takuma while also giving him food for thought. Takuma decides the time has come for a dicey attempt at introducing his wife Mina to his parents.
episodes.title: Episodio 11

episodes.synopsis: Takuma learns a lot about interpersonal relationships as he spends time at his parents' house introducing them to his new robot family. Will they each reach the compromise necessary to accept one another's perspectives?
episodes.title: Episodio 12

info.synopsis: Takuma è un uomo single che non fa altro che lavorare. Quando rientra è sempre troppo stanco per svolgere le faccende di casa, così decide di prendere un robot che se ne occupi. Mina-chan è così brava che Takuma dice scherzosamente che dovrebbe diventare sua moglie. Mina però lo prende sul serio e i due iniziano a fare sempre più cose insieme. Ma un umano e un robot possono davvero avere una relazione?
info.title: My Wife Has No Emotion

episodes.synopsis: Rosso viene convocato dal Professor Oak e, recandosi al laboratorio dello studioso, incontra il suo amico-rivale di sempre Blu. Ad entrambi Oak affida un Pokédex e un Pokémon iniziale: Rosso sceglie Charmander, mentre Blu opta per Squirtle. Dopo aver catturato alcuni Pokémon selvatici, Rosso si dirige verso Smeraldopoli, ma incontra Blu. Dopo uno scontro in cui il suo Charmander ha la peggio, l'allenatore incontra un ragazzo che gli suggerisce di recarsi nel più vicino Centro Pokémon e di provare la sua fortuna in una palestra. Durante la visita al museo di Plumbeopoli, Rosso decide di affrontare il capopalestra Brock, che si scopre essere l'allenatore incontrato in precedenza. Nello scontro, Brock utilizza Geodude, che viene sconfitto da Nidoran♂, e Onix. Quest'ultimo manda knock-out tutti i Pokémon di Rosso eccetto Charmander, che riesce a sconfiggerlo grazie alla mossa Millebave, usata in precedenza da Metapod. Rosso ottiene quindi la Medaglia Sasso e la Macchina Tecnica 34, contenente Pazienza.
episodes.title: Rosso

episodes.synopsis: Dopo aver sconfitto Brock, Rosso ottiene un fossile a Monte Luna e incontra un membro del Team Rocket. Riesce inoltre a sconfiggere i capipalestra Misty e Lt. Surge, ottenendo rispettivamente la Medaglia Cascata e la Medaglia Tuono. Tra gli strumenti in suo possesso figurano l'MN 01, l'Amo Vecchio e la Bicicletta. Raggiunto il Centro Pokémon di Lavandonia, Rosso è spinto a visitare la Torre Pokémon, ma l'infermiera gli suggerisce di recarsi al rifugio per Pokémon di Mr. Fuji. Lì apprende la storia di un cucciolo di Cubone orfano e scopre che il Team Rocket ha preso possesso della torre, in cui sembra vivere un fantasma. Blu decide di anticipare le mosse di Rosso, ma alla vista dello spettro, fugge a gambe levate, scontrandosi con il rivale che stava salendo. Rosso schiera il suo Charmeleon e, grazie alla Spettrosonda sottratta da Blu ad uno dei membri dell'organizzazione criminale, riesce a capire che lo spettro è in realtà Marowak, la madre di Cubone. Con l'aiuto di Cubone, Rosso mette in fuga il Team Rocket e salva Mr. Fuji che decide di donargli un Poké Flauto e due misteriose sfere.
episodes.title: Cubone

episodes.synopsis: Superata Lavandonia, Rosso sconfigge Erika, Koga e affronta Giovanni. Il suo Pokémon si evolve in Charizard prima di raggiungere Zafferanopoli. Qui scopre cosa sta succedendo nella sede dalla Silph SpA: il Team Rocket ha occupato l'edificio e tiene sotto ostaggio Pokémon e scienziati nel tentativo di sviluppare la Master Ball. Rosso irrompe nell'edificio, libera gli occupanti ma non riesce ad assicurare Giovanni alla giustizia. Sempre a Zafferanopoli, l'allenatore sconfigge la capopalestra Sabrina e in seguito, con il Lapras ottenuto da uno degli scienziati della Silph, si reca sull'Isola Cannella dove visita la Villa Pokémon e riceve da Blaine la Medaglia Vulcano. A Smeraldopoli Rosso incontra nuovamente Blu che ha già conquistato la Medaglia Terra del capopalestra più forte della regione. L'allenatore riesce ad accedere nella palestra dove scopre che il capopalestra di tipo Terra è Giovanni. Nonostante riesca a sconfiggere il Rhyhorn avversario, Rosso si ritrova in svantaggio, con il solo Charizard, nell'incontro con l'ultimo Pokémon di Giovanni, Rhydon. Infine Charizard manda al tappeto il Pokémon del capopalestra, ma Rosso rifiuta di accettare una medaglia dal leader del Team Rocket. Giovanni scioglie quindi l'organizzazione per consegnare a Rosso il lasciapassare per la Lega Pokémon di Kanto.
episodes.title: Giovanni

episodes.synopsis: Rosso supera la Via Vittoria e si ritrova a combattere i Superquattro sull'Altopiano Blu. Dopo aver sconfitto Lance, quest'ultimo vorrebbe proclamarlo Campione, ma gli annuncia che Blu lo ha anticipato e che, per ottenere il titolo, dovrà sconfiggerlo. Nonostante la debolezza del tipo, Charizard riesce a superare Blastoise, permettendo a Rosso e ai suoi Pokémon di entrare nella Sala d'onore. Una volta divenuto Campione, Rosso continua a catturare Pokémon nella regione, tra cui i Pokémon leggendari Articuno, Zapdos e Moltres, ma quando si reca dal Professor Oak per annunciargli di aver completato il Pokédex, scopre che Blu è stato attaccato da un Pokémon non presente tra i 149 catturati. Rosso decide quindi di recarsi nella Grotta Celeste per catturare Mewtwo, il Pokémon di cui parlavano i diari trovati nella Villa Pokémon. Il Pokémon leggendario resiste però con facilità agli attacchi dei Pokémon di Rosso, scaraventando l'allenatore e il suo Charizard in acqua. Quest'ultimo, deciso a non arrendersi, si megaevolve in MegaCharizard X, permettendo a Rosso di catturare Mewtwo e completare il Pokédex. Nell'epilogo, il Professor Oak si complimenta con Rosso e Blu per il lavoro svolto, quando Rosso scorge nella finestra alle sue spalle il Pokémon leggendario Mew e si lancia all'inseguimento per provare a catturarlo.

episodes.synopsis: Tony Stark arrives in Japan with the aim of setting up the Arc Station in the first step in his World Peace Initiative. In front of all of Japan, he announces his new Iron Man model, Iron Man Dio, with himself in the pilot's seat. But during the demo, Dio crashes after a mysterious bug in the operating system.
episodes.title: Episodio 1

episodes.synopsis: Tony Stark is accused by Defense Minister Kuroda of trying to avoid controversy by sneaking plutonium into Japan aboard an undefended cargo ship. This ship has been attacked and the plutonium stolen, posing a grave threat. Tony dons the Iron Man armor and vows to retrieve the plutonium and clear his name.
episodes.title: Episodio 2

episodes.synopsis: Nanami is trying to get to the bottom of the rash of freak hurricanes that have killed two notable scientists. Her search takes her to Professor Sakamoto, and his former student, Dr. Tanaka. Sakamoto and Tanaka were once part of something called the Tesla Project, which was working to control the weather. Is the Tesla project a part of the weird weather attacking Japan, and even if they figure that out, how do they stop it? Can Iron Man defeat the weather?
episodes.title: Episodio 3

episodes.synopsis: Tony Stark is backing a charity racing event in order to burnish the image of Stark Industries. Meanwhile, Kawashima, a race car driver who's suffered career-threatening injuries, is won over by A.I.M./Zodiac who promise him they will heal his injuries if he takes out Tony Stark.
episodes.title: Episodio 4

episodes.synopsis: Dr. Tanaka informs Tony that a mysterious epidemic has broken out near the Arc Station. The rampant and deadly disease appears unstoppable, and Tony initiates his own investigation into the cause. Meanwhile, the Self Defense Forces reconnaissance satellites are acting up, and Nagato Sakurai visits Iron Man to ask for his help. Stark and Sakurai join forces, when they discover the Zodiac Mech Aquarius may be behind both.
episodes.title: Episodio 5

episodes.synopsis: When the Arc Station has a series of malfunctions, Tony and Dr. Tanaka discover a Zodiac computer virus has infected the Station's operating systems. The virus spreads to the city's ATM banking computers, train navigation computers and traffic controls, causing chaos. Tony decides the only way to combat the virus is to draw it to another computer... his Iron Man onboard computer!
episodes.title: Episodio 6

episodes.synopsis: Tony and Dr.Tanaka are wake up on an isolated island with no idea how they got there and no hope of getting off the island. Missing his life-saving arc reactor and without his Iron Man armor, how will Tony and Chika be able to escape? And, who put them there in the first place?
episodes.title: Episodio 7

episodes.synopsis: Tony Stark meets Aki, a mysterious young girl with strange powers. Tony is shocked when the girl tells him that she belongs to Zodiac and mentions that she needs Tony, as Iron Man to protect her from Zodiac. Is Aki who she says she is? And even if she is, how can Tony trust her?
episodes.title: Episodio 8

episodes.synopsis: The plutonium needed to prime the Arc Station is stolen and Tony must don the Iron Man armor and fight against Dio. The two Iron Men must fight to the death, with the fate of Japan hanging in the balance.
episodes.title: Episodio 9

episodes.synopsis: "Iron Man is dead!" Dr. Chika Tanaka hears these astounding words from Yinsen's own lips. Meanwhile, the seriously wounded Tony Stark survives with the help of Nagato Sakurai and must devise a way to defeat Dio once and for all. But what awaits the arrival of Iron Man is not only Dio, but also four Iron Man Sigma models as well. How will Tony Stark overcome the hopeless situation he finds himself in?
episodes.title: Episodio 10

episodes.synopsis: Held responsible for the event at the Arc Station, Tony Stark is arrested by the Japanese government. But while being transported, explosions rock the Diet parliament building, and suspicions are raised that Stark is behind it. Will Tony Stark be able to clear his name, and take out the real threat behind the Diet bombing?
episodes.title: Episodio 11

episodes.synopsis: Tony Stark learns the shocking truth behind Zodiac. Iron Man must muster all his remaining strength in order to stop the nefarious ambitions of his greatest adversary, the man behind Zodiac. But, when an familiar face enters the battlefield, will he be able to do what needs to be done?
episodes.title: Episodio 12

info.synopsis: Tony Stark, amministratore delegato di un'azienda produttrice di armi, fisico, ingegnere e geniale inventore, viene ferito dalle schegge di un'arma da lui creata e rapito da un gruppo di terroristi. Mentre è prigioniero crea una tuta da combattimento e armato di questa riesce a fuggire. Da quel momento giura di dedicarsi a migliorare il mondo e non sprecare più la sua vita inutilmente. A tale scopo si reca in Giappone.
info.title: Iron Man

episodes.synopsis: When Yuki Miyata is hopsitalized with an illness, her best friend, Minami Kawashima, offers to take her place as manager of Hodokubo High School's baseball team, despite the fact she hates baseball herself. She buys Management: Tasks, Resposibilities, Practices by Peter Drucker which she later discovers is about business management as opposed to managing a baseball team, but Minami nonetheless becomes intrigued by its contents. Deciding that she first needs to 'define what the team is', she talks with Masayoshi Nakai, who hopes to become the team's CEO someday. Later, Yuki recalls a memory on how moved she was when Minami scored a winning bat during elementary school, which inspired her to join the baseball club. Having determined what the goal of the club is, Minami's decides to move onto the next step: Marketing.
episodes.title: Episodio 1

episodes.synopsis: Whilst trying to figure out how to apply marketing to her management, Minami becomes curious about the team's pitcher, Keiichirō Asano, who rarely shows up for practice, and co-manager Ayano Hōjō, who is very shy around others. Yuki mentions that Keiichirō is an alumni who rejoined his team, but became distant when he heard his favourite teacher got fired for allegedly beating students. Later, Yuki manages to get Ayano to talk about why she wanted to join the club, talking about how she wanted to change herself and make friends with others. Afterwards, Minami and Yuki hold interviews with the teammates to find out what they want out of the club. When it comes to Keiichirō's turn, he expresses dislike towards the team's coach, Makoto Kachi, who pulled him out of a recent game as he was concerned for his body's limits.
episodes.title: Episodio 2

episodes.synopsis: Despite showing some initial improvement, Minami notices the team being less motivated following a week of exams, with many members skipping practise. After school, Minami encounters Yūnosuke Sakurai opting for karaoke instead of practise, saying he's not worthy to be on the team following some of his slip-ups in the previous game. Looking to Management, she looks into 'consumerism', believing the absensees to be a form of boycott against the way they practise. Minami and Yuki ask Ayano for her help, who determines most players who only show up for games because of its competitive nature compared to practise. With this information, she and Makoto set up a new training exercise focused around teams and points which encourages the players to be more responsible and strive to improve themselves.
episodes.title: Episodio 3

episodes.synopsis: After just losing an exhibition match, Masayoshi, who is a little downhearted about not being in the starting lineup, feels that both he and the team need to change to make it to the nationals. Minami makes some suggestions to Masayoshi after reading about 'Innovation' in her book, before being harshly reminded about the promises she made to the other clubs who approached her. After talking with fellow teammate Jun Hoshide, Masayoshi decides to join the management team. Later, the team works on joint exercises with some of the other clubs Minami helped out with to mutual benefit. Later, as Masayoshi discusses innovation to the other managers, Minami suggests that Makoto aim to revolutionize high school baseball like other coaches before him. As an exhibition is being set up, Makoto reveals his innovative idea; the "no-bunt, no-ball" strategy.
episodes.title: Episodio 4

episodes.synopsis: As the team work on their strategy, designed to reduce the time the pitcher spends on the field and encourage defense, Minami learns Yuki is due to undergo surgery on the day of the exhibition match. It is revealed that Minami used to love baseball when she was little, but as she grew older, her hopes of becoming a professional baseball player were dashed. The exhibition match goes underway, with the team implimenting their new strategy to only aim for strikes. Whilst the match appears one-sided, the team notices their improvement as the game goes on. After managing to improve on defense, they start to impliment their no bunt strategy on offense which takes the other team by surprise. Despite losing the game, the team feels proud
episodes.title: Episodio 5

episodes.synopsis: With new members joining the club and more responsibilities piling up, including evaluations on the other players, Minami decides to impliment 'top management', splitting the various tasks amongst herself, Masayoshi, Ayano and Hanae. Minami becomes concerned that the growing number of applicants will result in many players never seeing the field, as well as leaving some of the other clubs empty-handed. She decides to focus on 'optimizing', interviewing each applicant and reducing them from 30 to 12 based on why they want to join the club, whilst reccomending those who didn't make the cut to other clubs, though she forgets about the evaluations in the process. After thinking about her observations and the interviews, Minami and Makoto manage to decide on a starting lineup for the upcoming tournament, appointing Masayoshi as the team captain.
episodes.title: Episodio 6

episodes.synopsis: The tournament begins, with the team winning their first five games thanks to their 'no bunt no ball' strategy, earning them a place in the quarter-finals. Afterwards, Yuki gives her thanks to Minami for all the courage she had given her the past year, though feels downhearted when Minami appears to put more focus on results than the overall experience. As the team start to struggle in the quarter-finals, Minami has the crowd sing Keiichirō's favourite song to give him encouragement, and the team make a comeback, winning thanks to the pinch runner, Fumiaki Kutsuki.
episodes.title: Episodio 7

episodes.synopsis: Hodokubo faces off against Shuuhoku in the semi-finals, whose pitcher is one of the most fearsome and has a rivalry with Jun. As the score remains tied up until the last inning, Jun manages to hit a home run in the last inning. As they try to defend their point, Yūnosuke makes a few mistakes, leading to the bases getting loaded, but thankfully the support of his team help them knock out the other players and win the match. As the management team discuss taking Yūnosuke off the starting lineup, due to the mistakes he makes under pressure. Minami insists that he kept in for similar reasons to Keiichirō. However, as Minami goes to the hospital, she learns that something terrible has happened to Yuki.
episodes.title: Episodio 8

episodes.synopsis: Yuki's condition takes a turn for the worse and she is put on life support, with nothing more that can be done to save her life. As Yuki's mother brings everyone to say their last goodbyes, Minami can't bear the bad news, wanting Yuki to fight through it, but her mother reveals that she had been fighting for a whole year despite being expected to only have three months to live. Minami feels guilty about the last thing she had said to Yuki before the quarter finals. Yuki passes away by the morning of the finals and Minami becomes angry, believing everything she has done has become pointless and blaming herself for making Yuki suffer for so long. As Minami reveals her hatred for baseball, it is revealed the team already knew having been told by Yuki. Conflicted, Minami runs off, but Ayano catches up to her, bringing her back to the stadium as the team are down 4-0. Overcoming her fears, Minami begins to cheer her heart out for her team.
episodes.title: Episodio 9

episodes.synopsis: With encouragement from Minami's cheers, the team start making a comeback making the score 4-3 as it comes to the last inning. With Yūnosuke forced to make the definitive bat, he makes the same play that Minami once did when she was younger, the play that inspired Yuki to love baseball, allowing the runners to reach home and clinch the match. As the team celebrate their victory, Minami has a vision of seeing Yuki, remembering all the good times they shared together. With the memories of Yuki in their hearts, the team moves on to the nationals, hoping to play baseball the way the customers want.
episodes.title: Episodio 10

info.synopsis: Decisamente particolare la trama del romanzo del 2009, il cui titolo si può tradurre all'incirca in "Cosa succede se una ragazza manager di una squadra di baseball del liceo legge "Management" di Drucker?, la storia infatti si dipana intorno alla figura di una normale liceale di nome Minami Kawashima, che diventa la manager della squadra di baseball della Hodokubo High School di Tokyo. A cambiare la sua vita, e quella della sua squadra, sarà l'acquisto casuale di Management: Tasks, Responsibilities, Practices, una delle più famose guide sulla produttività scritte di Peter Drucker; guidata dai consigli del guru austro-americano, Minami cercherà in tutti i modi di dare nuove motivazioni a una squadra ormai allo sbando.

episodes.synopsis: Two explorations of the Lolita complex. Sushiaki Karasawa, a young teacher at a Tokyo high school, becomes infatuated with Yoshida Chizuru, a 19-year-old student who appears in a shampoo commercial. She realizes he's attracted to her, so she shows up at his apartment and offers to sleep over. Soon he realizes that the games she plays have just begun.

What will Hiroyuki do when he finds out he's being thrown over for Azumi? Can Chizuru save her from Hiroyuki's revenge?
episodes.title: Volume 2

info.synopsis: Basato sul manga di Oku Hiroya. episodes.synopsis: The KarautsukiNumemon look for help for their village because legendary warriors have taken their womon and childmon hostage, but when they find out the gang is legendary warriors trouble is the result. What exactly is a Beast Spirit, and why is their now a slide evolution? The answers can be found.
episodes.title: La Digievoluzione Slide

episodes.synopsis: Takuya's and Koji's differences cause a lot of arguements, but when Tommy gets captured, can they put aside their differences and save him?
episodes.title: Il Paese dei Balocchi

episodes.synopsis: JP and Zoe arrive at a digimon school where one digimon, Tsunomon, is constantly being ignored. Can the two of them convience the other kids that digivolution isn't a bad thing?
episodes.title: Amici in pericolo!

episodes.synopsis: Tommy is tricked by a Bakumon causing his dreams to all be evil and make his friends appear evil. Can the digi-destined find a way to save him?
episodes.title: L'incubo di Tommy

episodes.synopsis: The digi-destined figure out that you need a Beast Spirit to defeat a Beast Spirit, but can they find there Beast Spirits before Grumblemon steals all of their spirits?
episodes.title: Il Digispirit Animale

episodes.synopsis: When Grottemon isolates koji, the others must find a way to defeat his Beast Spirit. Can Shamamon help them out when he's possessed?
episodes.title: Il villaggio dei veggenti

episodes.synopsis: Takuya gains control over his beast spirit, but can he maintain that control when he's forced into a one-on-one battle with Grumblemon?
episodes.title: Il coraggio di Tommy

episodes.synopsis: 4 of the 5 Dark Warriors decide to attack the digi-destined on a quest to gain their spirits. Can a little help from Sorcermon and Seraphimon help them to free the digital world?
episodes.title: I segreti di Digiworld

episodes.synopsis: Grumblemon returns to regain his beast spirit and seperates Takuya and Koji from the rest of the group, but when JP gains his beast spirit can he master it enough to finish off Grumblemon for good?
episodes.title: MetalKabuterimon, il guerriero del Tuono

episodes.synopsis: When the gang decodes to go on a water vacation, the Toucanmon steal the boys D-tectors. Can Zoe save the day without her beast spirit?
episodes.title: Il villaggio dei Toucanmon

episodes.synopsis: A group of Gomamon want to gain access to their island, but it's surronded by whirlpools and Zephrymon guards the way. Can the digi-destined find a way to save the world when the boys still don't have their D-tectors?
episodes.title: Il successo di Zoe

episodes.synopsis: Tommy finds the boys D-Tectors at the county fair, but he doesn't have anything to trade to get them back. Can he find something to trade to get them back before the Dark Legendary Warriors show up?
episodes.title: Il valore dell'onestà

episodes.synopsis: The digi-destined stop their battles briefly to participate in the Trailmon races, but can they find a way to stop the normal cheating that occurs?
episodes.title: Una gara disonesta

episodes.synopsis: The kids need some food, so they head to the Burgermon village. What will happen when they run into the master of wood?
episodes.title: Cuochi leggendari

episodes.synopsis: Arbormon wants revenge for his missing burgers, so he follows the kids into The Continent of Darkness, but what else has followed there?
episodes.title: Il Continente Oscuro

episodes.synopsis: When Duskmon proves to be too strong for the digi-destined, they have a new decision to make. What will it be?
episodes.title: Mistero invincibile

episodes.synopsis: Takuya decides to head home on a Dark Trailmon, but when he gets stuck as a Digimon in the real world, what will he do?
episodes.title: Takuya torna a casa

episodes.synopsis: Takuya returns to the digital world as a stronger Agunimon, but can he save his friends in a classic 2-on-1 showdown?
episodes.title: Il potere di un Digimon

episodes.synopsis: When the kids get sucked inside Sakkakumon, they must defeat their opponents and their own self doubts to get free, but will they succeed?
episodes.title: Il conflitto di JP

episodes.synopsis: Tommy gets a group of digimon in his dimension who pretend to be his friend, but can he figure out the truth before they steal his D-Tector?

episodes.title: Takuya contro Mercurymon

episodes.title: Il vero Kerpymon

episodes.synopsis: Cherubimon appears to be defeated, but he appears to be easy compared to IceDevimon. Can the others find a way to defeat IceDevimon with Takuya and Koji's D-Tectors frozen solid?
episodes.title: Il combattimento con IceDevimon

episodes.title: Salvate le Digiuova!

episodes.synopsis: The kids rush to try and save the Flame Terminal from being deleted, but with the SkullSatamon already on hand, can they find a way to defeat them? Is there any way to unite all the Digimon to fight together?
episodes.title: Scontro alla Città del Fuoco

episodes.synopsis: With only 3 areas left to protect in the digital world, the digi-destined must act fast to save the forest terminal. EmperorGreymon and MagnaGarurumon seem to be getting stronger, but will they finally be able to defeat the Royal Knights?

episodes.synopsis: The final battle with the Royal Knights is about to occur, but who will win this surprising bout?
episodes.title: Il destino dei Cavalieri Reali

episodes.synopsis: Since Emperor Greymon and MagnaGarurumon proved to be too weak, the kids decide to try a multi attack, but will it be enough, or will they need additional power?
episodes.title: Il sacrificio di Koichi

episodes.synopsis: Susannomon has been born, but will the combined powers of all 10 legendary spirits be enough to defeat Lucemon for good, or does Lucemon have one final surprise in store?
episodes.title: Pericolo sulla Terra

episodes.title: La vittoria finale

episodes.synopsis: Yuri, who has lost their memory, wakes up aboard the Interstellar Cruiser D.Q.O. They are taken by Setsu to participate in a meeting to identify the "Gnosia," a being that attacks and annihilates humans.
episodes.title: Episodio 1

episodes.synopsis: Yuri, who looped back to the first day, attends the meeting knowing who the Gnosia is. Yuri tries to cast suspicion on SQ, but the discussion doesn't progress as expected...?
episodes.title: Episodio 2

episodes.synopsis: Shigemichi and Stella join the group, and a meeting is held with seven people. During the meeting, Yuri uses their intuition to identify the Gnosia, but they struggle to convince the other crew members.
episodes.title: Episodio 3

episodes.synopsis: Despite identifying the Gnosia and surviving, Yuri finds themself back at the first day in a daze, when a person with an unusual presence, Yuriko, appears before them. She seems to know something, but...?
episodes.title: Episodio 4

episodes.synopsis: New crew members Comet and Chipie join the meeting. Two of the crew claim to be engineers, but Racio argues against voting for them, resulting in the votes going to...?
episodes.title: Episodio 5

episodes.synopsis: Yuri attends the meeting in a new role as the "Guardian Angel." With Jonas and Kukrushka joining, the meeting now has 13 people, and as the situation becomes chaotic, one crew member raises their hand.
episodes.title: Episodio 6

episodes.synopsis: Otome and Remnan join in and the meeting is about to begin, but the other new crew member, Sha-Ming, refuses to come out of his room. Meanwhile, Shigemichi begins to talk about his feelings for Stella.
episodes.title: Episodio 7

episodes.synopsis: Remnan and Kukrushka step forward as "Guard Duty," a role that confirms they are human. As the number of positions increases and the meeting becomes more complicated, Sha-Ming, who is suspected by Kukrushka, takes a certain action...
episodes.title: Episodio 8

episodes.synopsis: Yuri awakens as a Gnosia. Though they feel hesitant about deceiving their fellow crew members, they are touched by the feelings of Comet, who shares their position, and resolve to fulfill their role as promised to Setsu.
episodes.title: Episodio 9

episodes.synopsis: Yuri, who has looped once again, is astonished by their new appearance. Amidst this, the meeting is postponed due to Sha-Ming's absence, and Raqio reveals the secret of the Silver Key to the bewildered Yuri.
episodes.title: Episodio 10

episodes.synopsis: Upon waking up, Yuri finds themself in a loop where they and SQ are on Guard Duty. Knowing that they are both human, the two grow closer, and eventually SQ reveals her true "identity"—.
episodes.title: Episodio 11

episodes.synopsis: Gina, who intensely dislikes lying and deceiving others, is confided in about the loops by Yuri. Recalling a painful past, she expresses her fears and resistance toward becoming a Gnosia.
episodes.title: Episodio 12

episodes.synopsis: Before the meeting, Setsu loses consciousness and is taken to the Sickbay. As they share the information they have acquired, Yuri suggests that Setsu, who appears exhausted from having repeated hundreds of loops, take a break. The "Truth Arc" begins...
episodes.title: Episodio 13

episodes.synopsis: "If you survive this loop, I'll tell you everything." Yuri, presented with a condition by Yuriko, attends a meeting where all 15 crew members are gathered. However, once the meeting begins, an unexpected proposal comes from Yuriko.
episodes.title: Episodio 14

episodes.synopsis: Raqio, who was identified as a Gnosia by the Engineer, Yuri, claims innocence based on a certain action. The emergence of an AC Follower throws the meeting into chaos, and Yuri is cornered.
episodes.title: Episodio 15

episodes.synopsis: When Yuri awakens, it's in a world line where the ship has escaped Gnosia contamination. As Yuri is bewildered by Kukrushka's implication of "the end of the universe," an alarm blares detecting an abnormal biological reaction.
episodes.title: Episodio 16

episodes.synopsis: Yuri learns the truth: that they are a "Bug" that shouldn't exist. They struggle to escape the time loop and the cosmic collapse caused by their dual existence, but...?
episodes.title: Episodio 17

episodes.synopsis: Yuri awakens on "DAY 0," the day before the loop they always experience and before escaping Liu-An. They meet Setsu there, but Setsu seems unaware of the Silver Key or the loops...
episodes.title: Episodio 18

episodes.synopsis: Yuri has escaped the loop, but the crew members have lost all memory of Setsu. On the planet where they land, Yuri follows Setsu's traces, only to be confronted with the harsh fact that Setsu's very existence has vanished.
episodes.title: Episodio 19

episodes.synopsis: In order to end Setsu's loop, Yuri obtains Raqio's "Silver Key." As Yuri tries to host the key once again, Raqio calls out to them.
episodes.title: Episodio 20

episodes.synopsis: Yuri reunites with Setsu on the other side of the dimensional door. They find themselves in the world line before they received the Silver Key that first awakened them. And so, their final discussion begins――
episodes.title: Episodio 21

info.synopsis: Le Gnosia mentono. Fingendo di essere umane, stermineranno tutti gli abitanti dell'universo, uno alla volta. L'equipaggio di un'astronave alla deriva, minacciato dalle letali "Gnosia" e senza avere idea di chi sia il vero nemico, escogita un disperato piano per sopravvivere. I membri più sospetti verranno messi in animazione sospesa, uno alla volta, per tentare di eliminare le Gnosia dall'astronave. Tuttavia, è quasi impossibile capire se le persone in animazione sospesa siano davvero delle Gnosia o dei semplici capri espiatori, sacrificati dalle Gnosia per assicurarsi la sopravvivenza. Riusciranno gli umani a trionfare? O sarà l'inizio della fine per l'umanità?
info.title: Gnosia

episodes.synopsis: Rinne, a girl who cannot see faces and is from a family of exorcists, heads to her first mission with the power of the storm god, Yakumo. They defeat a series of specters, but face an unforeseen monster with black crystals and infinite regeneration. As their situation becomes critical, the mysterious man, Jugemu, saves them.
episodes.title: Episodio 1

episodes.synopsis: Jugemu, who possesses the power to destroy the regenerating monsters, is supported in battle by a woman named Neo. Rinne questions them about their identities, the monsters' true nature, and the "Master Orb" that Jugemu mentioned, but the two give no answers. The next day, however, Rinne notices that Jugemu is tailing her on school premises.
episodes.title: Episodio 2

episodes.synopsis: After Jugemu and his allies defeat a horde of monsters known as "core holders" who were attacking the city, a new swarm appears, accompanied by a masked man who targets Rinne's estate. Jugemu and the others move to intercept, but they are overwhelmed by the immense power of the Ruinous-class monster Shuringala, summoned by the masked man. The man then reaches for Rinne...
episodes.title: Episodio 3

episodes.synopsis: Rinne's world begins to collapse after the Masked Man (World User) steals half of the Master Orb. Determined to retrieve it, Rinne pursues the World User to another world facing destruction. There, Rinne and her allies encounter Masamune, a girl who calls herself a "Protective Sword" (Gotō).」
episodes.title: Episodio 4

episodes.synopsis: Leaving Masamune's world, the group travels to another world whose Master Orb was stolen. They arrive at a battlefield where the revolutionary army, led by the military genius Kirinji, fights an army of grotesque "Core Beasts." The team offers to fight alongside Kirinji's forces. Amidst the conflict, Yakumo notices a heavy burden that Rinne is secretly grappling with.
episodes.title: Episodio 5

episodes.synopsis: A signal from the World Reavers resurfaces in Neo's world-a world that has already lost its Master Orb. Its source is a massive structure drifting in space. It's an enormous core holder plummeting toward the planet! To prevent it from crashing into the surface, Neo and the others launch into space, infiltrate the core holder's interior, and begin a desperate mission to destroy the core!
episodes.title: Episodio 6

episodes.synopsis: The masked man shatters the barrier protecting the White Archive and a massive army of core holders pours inside. His goal is the Primordial Orb, said to be sealed in the deepest chamber of the Archive. With Jugemu absent, the one who stands in the World Reaver's way is the guardian deity of Strike Island-Godstriker.
episodes.title: Episodio 7

episodes.synopsis: The Primordial Orb falls into the hands of the World Reaver Anger. Ominous dark clouds spread over Strike Island. However, Jugemu, now empowered with new strength, defeats the Ruinous-class monster Kakagosedec and corners Anger. Seizing a brief opportunity to escape, Anger absorbs the power of Caliente Volcano in order to eliminate the IrregularsI
episodes.title: Episodio 8

episodes.synopsis: After transforming into a flame monster, Anger is finally defeated by Jugemu. But suddenly, another World Reaver appears and cuts Jugemu in half. Witnessing this, Rinne awakens, and her spirit gun unleashes a massive blast of light that hurtles toward the World Reaver!
episodes.title: Episodio 9

episodes.synopsis: Having reclaimed the Master Orb from the World Reaver Nowhere, Rinne awakens to her true power. But Nowhere, too, transforms into a terrifying monster, declaring that he "won't look at what doesn't need to be seen" as he attacks with overwhelming might. Yet within Rinne burns with the strength of all the bonds she has forged... The final battle between Rinne and Nowhere begins.
episodes.title: Episodio 10

episodes.synopsis: Cinque nobili casate risiedono nei Quartieri delle dame, una sezione della corte interna del Regno di Ei. Reirin, la dama della casata dei Kou, è la favorita del principe ereditario Gyoumei, grazie alla bellezza e alle qualità eccezionali. All'opposto, Keigetsu, dama della casata degli Shu, ha fama di essere malvagia ed è odiata da tutti a corte. Alla Festa del doppio sette, Keigetsu usa la magia proibita per scambiare il suo corpo con quello di Reirin. Quando "Reirin" si sveglia, Keigetsu è condannata a morte. Nonostante il pericolo imminente, la ragazza, da sempre cagionevole, è felice di trovarsi in un corpo così sano...
episodes.title: Una pessima cattiva

episodes.synopsis: A seguito del trambusto nella corte interna, la consorte imperiale Shu ordina a Reirin di cambiare residenza, mandandola sostanzialmente in esilio. Poiché la nuova sistemazione è praticamente un magazzino abbandonato, Leelee l'ancella personale di Keigetsu, sfoga tutta la frustrazione accumulata fino a quel momento. Dopo aver gridato contro Reirin, Leelee le dice che non è disposta a prendersi cura di lei e se ne va. Reirin rimane sola, piena di gioia per la sua nuova libertà...
episodes.title: Dovrò vivere qui?

episodes.synopsis: Sono passati quattro giorni dallo scambio di corpi. Reirin, bandita in un capanno all'interno del Palazzo Shu, si dedica al giardinaggio grazie al corpo in buona salute di Keigetsu. Godendo di una nuova libertà in cui non è costretta ad affidarsi agli altri, Reirin prova finalmente un senso di soddisfazione. Nel frattempo, Leelee viene spinta da Gayou, un'ancella di alto rango della casata Kin, a tormentare Reirin...
episodes.title: Testa alta, schiena dritta

episodes.synopsis: Keigetsu, suffering from a severe fever, controls a flame to seek help from Reirin. Reirin feels heartbroken seeing Keigetsu managing to calm herself down. Reirin suggests the cancellation of the swap, but the request is rejected. For the upcoming Ghost Festival ritual, Reirin presents Leelee with a garment she had sewn just for Leelee. Meanwhile, Leelee feels that something is off from a certain phrase Reirin unintentionally uttered.
episodes.title: La mia cometa miracolosa

episodes.synopsis: To settle the score with Gayou who enticed Leelee into harassment, Reirin takes Leelee in tow and heads to the Ghost Festival ritual. Not flinching that a seat was not prepared for her, Reirin wearing a handmade garment with beautiful embroidery stands dignified in the hall. In due time, the offerings of dances by the Maidens begin. Seika of the Kin clan who is hosting the ritual dances brilliantly...
episodes.title: Chi è quella ragazza?

episodes.synopsis: Reirin finds it suspicious that Seika said there is no one named Gayou in the Kin clan. Just when she was about to ask for details, the Kou clan court lady Tousetsu comes in with a notice that "Reirin's" life is in danger! Reirin wishes to save "Reirin's" life, but Gyoumei refuses the offer, saying he doesn't trust her. However, the empress Kou Kenshuu tells Reirin that nursing will be allowed if she can show her sincerity by drawing the Bow of Warding all night long.
episodes.title: Non vi lascerò morire

episodes.synopsis: After drawing the Bow of Warding continuously, Reirin falls unconscious. Reirin awakens to see Tousetsu, who has caught onto the swapping of the Maidens. Around the same time, Keigetsu realizes that a curse was placed on a gift given to her. Meanwhile, at the Maiden Court, a tea party is being held in celebration of "Reirin's" recovery. There, Kenshuu reminisces about her days as a Maiden that she spent together with Shu Gabi, the Noble Consort.
episodes.title: Sapete perché voglio regalarvi un'anima?

episodes.synopsis: Keigetsu realizes that the cause of her illness is a curse created by venomcraft, and has an idea who placed such a curse... Visitation gifts from Seika makes Reirin hypothesize that someone is scheming to make it seem as though the harassment was done by the Kin clan. Worried about Keigetsu, Reirin speaks to a flame. Keigetsu appears in the flame as if to answer that call. But then, Keigetsu asks Reirin for help...
episodes.title: Comportati da cattiva!

episodes.synopsis: Reirin realizes that Kenshuu's agony is that of a curse, which gives her an understanding of Gabi's true objective. Reirin asks Gyoumei if she can borrow the Bow of Warding once more, but he will not heed her request. Unable to give up, Reirin heads over alone to see Keigetsu and have the swap cancelled. Right as she passes by Gyoumei, a certain image catches his eye...
episodes.title: Vi salverò a tutti i costi

episodes.synopsis: Gyoumei realizes the swap between Reirin and Keigetsu and heads over to the Kou Palace in pursuit of Reirin. Tousetsu is inquired about the circumstances by Gyoumei but cannot divulge the truth because of her promise with Reirin. Gyoumei gets the hint from Tousetsu's behavior and shows his resolve by voluntarily removing his crown. Meanwhile, Reirin heads back to the Shu Palace with Keigetsu in tow to deal with the curse...
episodes.title: Condivideremo la maledizione

episodes.synopsis: With the plans to murder Kenshuu using a curse out in the open, Gabi is cornered. She tries to slash Reirin, but is pinned down on the spot. With everything settled, Reirin and Keigetsu decide to cancel the swap. As they are enveloped in flames, the two Maidens tell each other how they feel...
episodes.title: Una cattiva coi fiocchi

info.synopsis: Nel palazzo di Hina vengono riunite le principesse di cinque famiglie per formare la nuova generazione di imperatrici. Reirin, una ragazza fragile ma dalla grande bellezza, si ritrova nel corpo di un'altra pretendente al trono, la gelosa Keigetsu. Nessuno crede a Reirin, che nel corpo di Keigetsu si ritrova improvvisamente odiata da tutti e chiamata “principessa ratto”. info.synopsis: Kurumi Fukuga è una studentessa universitaria di 20 anni segnata da un evento traumatico del suo passato. Anni prima, sua madre si era avvicinata al mondo del trading Forex (FX) nella speranza di guadagnare facilmente, ma una grave crisi finanziaria e decisioni sbagliate la portarono ad accumulare un debito enorme. Schiacciata dalla vergogna e dalla disperazione, la donna si tolse la vita, lasciando Kurumi con un profondo senso di colpa e rimpianto. Decisa a dare un significato a quella tragedia, Kurumi sceglie di affrontare lo stesso mondo che ha distrutto la sua famiglia: il mercato FX. Il suo obiettivo è chiaro e ossessivo, recuperare i 20 milioni di yen perduti dalla madre. Tra grafici, operazioni rischiose e continui sbalzi emotivi, Kurumi scopre quanto il trading possa essere crudele e psicologicamente logorante.
